description: This file is a test file for a React application, specifically testing that the application renders a page with the title 'Learning Insights Platform'. It imports testing utilities from '@testing-library/react', routing components from 'react-router-dom', and application components including App and AuthProvider. The test verifies that the main page renders correctly with the expected title.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case that renders the App component wrapped with routing and authentication contexts, then checks for the presence of the homepage title.
